artworks.title: Nicolaus Petri van Deventer
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man with one arm bent on a table and his other hand on a globe. He has a full beard, mustache, pronounced nose, deep-set eyes, and short hair. He wears a textured doublet with a ruff collar. Various scientific objects surround him, including a globe, an armillary sphere, and geometric instruments. In the background, there is a scene with a figure holding a trumpet and a building with columns. A Latin inscription is visible at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Hieronymus Scholiers
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is positioned at a slight angle, turning his head to gaze outward. His facial features include a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a pointed nose, and a short beard and mustache. His hair is short and wavy. He is dressed in a high-necked garment with a prominent frilled collar and puffed sleeves, typical of formal attire from the period depicted. There is no visible jewelry, but the buttons of his garment are visible. The background consists of an oval frame with the Latin text "Bene agere et nil timere," along with other inscriptions indicating his age as "30" and the year as "1583." The artwork is a finely detailed black and white illustration, likely an engraving.

artworks.title: Ascending Ornament
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate ornamental design. The design is highly detailed and symmetrical, featuring intertwining floral motifs, leafy patterns, and scrolling vines. The artwork shows Renaissance-style decoration with roundels containing faces and possibly grotesques or cherubic figures riding fantastical creatures like decorative horses. At the center, the name "Lambrecht Hopfer" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Ascending Ornament
artworks.description: The image displays swirling, symmetrical shapes and lines woven together to form an abstract composition. The lines resemble leaves and vines, creating an impression of ornate foliage. Faces resembling cherubs or mythical figures are interspersed within the design, with some heads crowned by leaves or tendrils. The arrangement suggests movement, as if the shapes are billowing like smoke or steam, evoking classical art found in decorative architecture.

artworks.title: Autumn
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an autumn scene with two figures collecting fruit. In the foreground, a figure on the left reaches for a bunch of grapes from a tree while the figure on the right holds a basket filled with fruits. The scene includes a goat and a pig in the background. The scene is surrounded by foliage and a landscape that extends into the distance. The drawing has detailed textures and shading.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The engraving displays two individuals walking together, holding hands. One person is a woman wearing an elaborate dress and styled hair, looking towards her companion. The other person is a man in a cloak and hat with a feather, with long curly hair visible. A small dog is by their feet. Behind them are trees, buildings, people, and windmills in a rural setting. The sky has swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait at the Easel
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in profile facing left. It appears to be an older man with distinct facial features, like a prominent nose and high cheekbones. His short hair seems to show signs of aging. He is wearing a dark jacket with a visible white collar. The man's right hand is raised to sketch or write on a vertical surface. In the background, there is light cross-hatching shading. No jewelry or additional objects are noticeable.

artworks.title: Marcus Valerius Corvus
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with one foot forward, facing away from the viewer. The individual is holding a large round shield with their right hand. They are wearing a helmet with a plume and decorative carvings, and have a muscular back. A cape drapes over their left shoulder and back, with its folds caught in the wind. They have a garment around their waist with ties down the back and a short sword attached. The background shows a detailed landscape with soldiers or figures in action, set against a cloudy sky. The ground is rocky with trees and foliage on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Mucius Scaevola
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular man in a dynamic pose, holding a sword with both hands. He looks off into the distance, with defined facial features including a jawline, eyebrows, and a mustache. He wears an elaborate helmet with a winged creature, a tattered tunic exposing his torso, a flowing cloak, and winged figures around his calves. The background depicts chaos with figures in action, smoke, and hills under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows two children in an engraving style, standing from head to toe. The child on the left has a youthful face and short hair, wearing a traditional 17th-century outfit. The child on the right also has a youthful face with styled hair, wearing a dress and holding a bouquet. Pastoral elements surround them, including a goat and a deer-like animal. In the background are lush trees, distant hills, and wisps forming cherubs. The bottom corners depict detailed foliage.

artworks.title: Summer
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows two people depicted from head to toe. One person stands on the left, holding a staff over their shoulder and a bundle of wheat in their arms. They have curly hair adorned with a small wreath of wheat or leaves, and they are covered with rustic or natural attire made of leaves or straw. The other person stands on the right, facing the first person, with an arm on their shoulder. Their hair is pulled back into a braided style, and they wear a long, layered dress, holding a yoke across their shoulders with buckets on either side. They stand barefoot on grassy ground, with a cow with a bell around its neck next to them, grazing. A chicken is pecking at the ground near the pair. In the background, a pastoral scene unfolds with fields being harvested, small buildings, and a church steeple visible. Above, there is an image of a cherub flanked by clouds, playing an instrument in a ray of light.

artworks.title: The Captain of the Infantry
artworks.description: The image shows a man outdoors in historical noble attire, including a wide-brimmed hat with feathers, a ruffled collar, a patterned doublet with puffed sleeves, and short trousers. He is standing with a turned posture, holding a staff with tassels. A sword hangs from his waist. In the background, there is a military scene with soldiers, hills, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Françoise van Egmond
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing with her body turned slightly to the left, facing the viewer. She is holding a skull with her right hand and a handkerchief with her left hand. The woman has a high, rounded forehead, arched eyebrows, narrow eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth. Her hair is styled intricately with feathers and a decorative hairpiece. She is wearing a detailed dress with puffed sleeves, a ruffled collar, and a jeweled bodice. Accessories include layered necklaces and bracelets on her right wrist. The image is framed by an oval border with the inscription "Damoiselle Franchoyse Degmont," and the background is textured.

artworks.title: Presentation
artworks.description: The image shows four people depicted in a medieval artistic style. The figures are positioned around a large rectangular block resembling an altar or table. The first woman, on the left, is dressed in a blue garment with a white head covering and is holding a small basket-like object. The second woman is wearing green and red garments with a white headpiece. The third figure, a small child, is sitting on the altar with a golden halo around their head. The child is unclothed and has a hand resting on the arm of the man standing on the right. He is wearing a long red robe and a blue head covering, with a full beard and mustache. The background features arched structures with red and green segments, and the floor has a green pattern, contributing to the image's vibrant color palette.

artworks.title: Christopher Plantin
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a robe standing in a landscape. He is holding a pair of compasses above a book, with one hand resting on a ledge. The man has a beard and mustache, short wavy hair, and is wearing a luxurious garment with fur collar and decorative elements. There is a column on the right and a landscape with trees, mountains, and cloudy sky on the left.

artworks.title: Gerrit de Jong
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man standing confidently. His left hand is on his hip and his right hand holds a decorative staff. He has short, curly hair, high cheekbones, and a sharp gaze. The man wears a detailed outfit with a high collar, patterned jacket, puffed trousers, a sash, tights, ornate shoes, and a sword at his hip. The background features a detailed landscape with plowed fields, sparse vegetation, and distant hills. There is text at the bottom in a script-style font.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene in a cave with animals and gifts being offered. The drawing depicts figures in varied positions around a central scene that includes an adult figure holding a child with halos above their heads. Around them are individuals presenting objects to the central figures. To the left, more figures are gathered, including a procession towards the scene. In the background, there are architectural elements such as stone buildings and an archway, with a radiant celestial body illuminating the scene from above. The lines are carefully etched, providing a detailed and textured depiction.

artworks.title: Pietà (The Sorrowing Virgin with the Dead Christ in Her Lap)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in the foreground. The first figure is a man lying down, looking lifeless. The man has long hair and a beard, and is partially covered with a cloth. The second figure is a woman seated to the man's left. She is dressed in layered clothing and has a cloth covering her head. The woman's eyes are closed, and she is touching the man's torso. Both figures are surrounded by a radiant aura. In the background, there are hills, distant figures, a cross, and a city silhouette. Beside the figures, there is a crown of thorns on the ground.

artworks.title: Georgiana (Spencer), Duchess of Devonshire
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing on a stone balustrade. She is positioned in the center, with her body slightly leaning to the right. Her right hand is on the rail, and her left hand is by her side. She has fair skin, delicate facial features, and an aristocratic appearance. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with a large feather and possible jewelry. She wears an elegant, flowing gown with rich fabric and intricate details. The background features trees, a cloudy sky, and a sculpture on a pedestal in a manicured garden. The scene conveys a serene and refined atmosphere blending nature and classical architecture.

artworks.title: William Innes
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after Lemuel Francis Abbott
artworks.description: The image shows two men in full-length view standing in an outdoor setting. The man in the foreground stands facing slightly to the side and holds a golf club over his shoulder. He has a smooth face and is wearing a large-brimmed hat, with light curly hair visible underneath. He is dressed in a 18th-century-style outfit: a buttoned jacket with ornate shoulder decorations, knee-length breeches, and tall socks tucked into buckle shoes. The man in the background stands behind him with a more relaxed posture. He has longer hair under a tricorn hat and wears a long coat while holding multiple golf clubs. The background features an expansive landscape with a large house, fields, and a windmill, bordered by a wooden fence. The sky appears cloudy, providing a classic, serene backdrop to the scene.

artworks.title: Henry Laurens
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after John Singleton Copley
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a chair. He is facing slightly to the side, one arm resting on a table, and the other on the back of the chair. The man has a composed expression, soft facial features, and a prominent nose. His hair is styled in a formal manner typical of the 18th century. He is dressed in elaborate attire, including a tailcoat, waistcoat, breeches, stockings, and shoes with buckles. A ruffled white shirt is visible under his coat sleeves. On the table beside him, there are various objects including rolled-up papers with writing, a quill pen, an inkpot, and closed books. He holds a long staff or cane. The background includes thick drapery with tassels and a column, and in a faded section, a landscape with trees can be seen.

artworks.title: The Wright Family (The Bradshaw Children)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an outdoor setting. The first person, a young woman, is seated on the ground, facing right, holding a lamb. The second woman is seated next to her, also facing right. A young boy is seated to the right of the women, looking up. There is a tree in the left background and a cloudy sky in the right background.

artworks.title: George Washington
artworks.artist: Valentine Green, after Thomas Stothard, after Charles Willson Peale

artworks.title: The George Inn, Beaconsfield
artworks.description: The image features a low, street-level view of an alleyway between old buildings. The horizon is obscured by the structures, with tiled roofs creating a jagged line against the sky. Birds are seen in flight. The pen and ink drawing uses precise lines to depict building textures and cobblestones. The color palette is black ink on cream-colored paper. In the foreground are two figures, alongside barrels and a covered cart. Details like shingles, bricks, and wood emphasize the historic atmosphere.
